description: This file contains utility functions related to processing prompt messages and content conversion for the OpenAI completion in the litellm project.

methods.name: is_tokens_or_list_of_tokens(value: List)
methods.description: Checks whether the provided value is a list of integers or a list of lists of integers, representing tokens.

methods.name: AllPromptValues _transform_prompt( messages: Union[List[AllMessageValues], List[OpenAITextCompletionUserMessage]], )
methods.description: Transforms a list of message objects into a prompt string or list of strings suitable for OpenAI completions by processing content and handling tokens.
